usage.callShape: POST https://x402.orth.sh/zai/api/paas/v4/videos/generations with JSON body {model, prompt} (model required = "cogvideox-3"; prompt or image_url required). Returns 200 with an async job {id, task_status:"PROCESSING"}; then GET https://x402.orth.sh/zai/api/paas/v4/async-result/{id} (free, no payment) until task_status="SUCCESS".
usage.outputShape: Submit: body.id (job id), body.task_status ("PROCESSING"). Poll result: body.task_status ("SUCCESS"/"PROCESSING"/"FAIL"), final video at body.video_result[0].url (mp4), thumbnail at body.video_result[0].cover_image_url.
quirks: Async two-step: the paid POST only QUEUES the job and returns task_status:PROCESSING — it does NOT return the video. You MUST poll to get the result.
Poll URL is GET {origin}/zai/api/paas/v4/async-result/{id} using the id from the submit response. Polling is FREE (no x402 payment).

Completion took ~20 polls (roughly 2-3 minutes); poll every ~6-8s, allow up to 40 polls. While pending the poll body is minimal {id, model, task_status:PROCESSING}; on SUCCESS it gains video_result[].
Read the final video from video_result[0].url (an mp4 on mfile.z.ai). The mp4 URL carries a watermark filename and may be time-limited — download promptly.
model field is required and must be 'cogvideox-3'. Either prompt or image_url must be supplied (prompt alone works).
Payment is single-charge at submit only ($0.01 on Base USDC); polling does not charge again.
usage.guide: POST to https://x402.orth.sh/zai/api/paas/v4/videos/generations with JSON {"model":"cogvideox-3","prompt":"<your scene>"} (pay $0.01 USDC on Base via x402). You get back a job with an id and task_status:"PROCESSING" — this is async, the video is NOT in this response. Then repeatedly GET https://x402.orth.sh/zai/api/paas/v4/async-result/{id} (free) every ~6-8 seconds until task_status becomes "SUCCESS" (allow a few minutes / up to 40 polls). When successful, the video mp4 URL is at video_result[0].url and a cover image at video_result[0].cover_image_url. Optional params: quality ("speed"|"quality"), duration (5|10), fps (30|60), with_audio (bool), size, image_url[] for image-to-video.
